title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 171
paragraphs: Next after the Asbystae to the west come the Auschisae. These live above Barca and reach down to the sea at Euesperides. In the middle of the Auschisae's territory live the Bacales, a small tribe, who reach down to the sea at the city of Taucheira in Barcan territory; these practice the same customs as those above Cyrene.
